chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Mansur ibn Buzraj, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him) saying: 'Washing the head with the sidr (lotus/jujube) brings livelihood with a strong bringing.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of washing the head with sidr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam Al-Rida (AS) links the physical act of washing the head with Sidr to the spiritual and material attraction of Rizq (sustenance). In Shia tradition, this reflects the broader principle of 'tawassul' through natural means, where specific created things serve as vessels for divine grace and blessings.
